parameters.content:
## AI Invoice Data Extractor

**Setup:**
1. Connect OpenAI API, Gmail OAuth2, Google Sheets OAuth2
2. Set spreadsheet ID for accounting ledger
3. POST to webhook: `{"invoice_text": "full invoice text or OCR output...", "notify_email": "accounting@company.com"}`

Extracts vendor, amounts, dates, line items from invoice text using GPT-4o, logs to Sheets, and sends confirmation email.
